name: Forum Monsoon Open 2019

venue.name: Forum Shantiniketan Mall, Whitefield
venue.address: Forum Shantiniketan, Whitefield Main Rd, Thigalarapalya, Krishnarajapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067

information:
Please note once you register in WCA site for the Forum Monsoon Open 2019, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. The duties will be assigned by a software and finalised by the organising team in consultation with the delegates. This information will be provided to all participants at least 2 days before the event. We will also ensure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.

Contact 9493560605 or 7008390532 for additional queries.
